sentences.text: The sensor data shows a significant increase in appliance energy in the house between 05:40 and 06:00, which the system described as 'the machines waking up'.
The observed energy usage was 270 Wh, which is considerably higher than the expected 60 Wh and far outside the expected range of 33 Wh to 82 Wh.
This sudden spike probably indicates a routine morning activity, such as several appliances starting up at once.
